items.html: Thus, the upper head of Atik was revealed in the two heads of AA together, for it was revealed in the seven corrections of the skull, and also in the brain, and in the beard that comes out of the brain, as mentioned. And it is found that just as the seven lower [Sefirot] of Atik are revealed in the seven of the skull, so they are revealed in the beard of AA. And I did not receive their order in detail.
